strings.jp:
貴方に恨みは無いが…
これも戦場の習︀い。お覚悟ッ!
strings.en:
I bear you no grudge... but
war is war. Have at you!

strings.jp:
まさか貴殿と刃を交えることに
なるとはな…かかって参られよ!
strings.en:
To think we'd cross blades...
Come at me, then!

strings.jp:
陛下が認めた戦乙女の力……
み…見届けましたぞ……
strings.en:
The Valkyrie His Majesty
chose... I have seen it...

strings.jp:
死なすには悩しい…
味方に欲しい人物だった……
strings.en:
A pity to kill him... I'd have
wanted him as an ally...

strings.jp: まさか、軍神に勝てるとは…
strings.en:
To think I beat the
God of War...

strings.jp: さ、さすがはバルドゥス殿…!

貴殿はかつての戦友。
抵抗しなければ、命は保障しよう
strings.en:
We were comrades once.
Yield, and thou shalt live.
